angle.hook: a free crime game most people had not heard of drew 365,092 concurrent players on Steam, per SteamDB via Denfaminicogamer
angle.why_now: Denfaminicogamer reported the peak on 14 Nov, about ten days after the Early Access launch, and the Arabic press has not carried it yet
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players can try it free on Steam, but Steam rates it Mixed and the game has no Arabic, English Russian French German Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese only
angle.payoff: the peak figure comes from one outlet citing SteamDB which we could not open, so it is a report, and Steam's own reviews are Mixed
